summary: Reviewed the branch against its merge base with main (fcc6d05). The branch forked before task-01 was merged, so a plain `git diff main` also shows task-01's changes in reverse; those are not part of this task. The task's own change is small and correct. setBtn(on) in js/markdown/dictation.js swaps data-i, data-i-title and data-i-aria to the new i18n keys dictateStopBtn, dictateStopTip and dictateStopAria. The keys exist in both ro and en, with diacritics, and the values match the agreed wording exactly: '⏹ Oprește înregistrarea' / '⏹ Stop recording', tooltip 'Oprește dictarea' / 'Stop dictation'. setBtn then repaints immediately, and on stop it removes aria-label and data-i-aria so the markup is back to its original state. applyUILang() (i18n.js:889-895) repaints [data-i], title and aria-label from those keys, so switching language mid-recording works for the text, the tooltip and the accessible name. setBtn is the single place every stop path goes through: manual stop, fail(), the live engine's onerror/onend, and closeIdeaModal. Because it picks the button from `target`, the toolbar button and the idea-box button each change only when they are the one recording. The API path reverts the button while the 'Transcriu…' pill is still showing, as the product owner asked. The existing red .active style is untouched. Icon-only mode is limited to #btn-dictate.active inside the toolbar's existing @media (max-width: 700px) block, using font-size:0 plus a 13px ::before '⏹' that matches the .tb-btn size there; the full text stays in title and aria-label, as agreed in the product owner's q4 answer. FEATURES.md § J gained a short, accurate paragraph. The tester's stop-label.js suite checks what it claims: exact strings, title and aria in both languages; both engines, with a stubbed SpeechRecognition covering onend restart and onerror; the unconfigured and mic-denied fail paths; the button reverting while transcription is still pending; the two buttons staying independent; language switches mid-recording in both directions; and computed-style checks at 390, 700 and 701 px. I could not run commands in this session (Bash was refused), so I did not re-run the suite, /verify, or a test merge with main. This verdict relies on the tester's green report plus my own reading of the code, and nothing in that reading contradicts the report. Non-blocking notes for whoever merges: (1) a root package-lock.json was committed with no root package.json on this branch; it is a harmless dev-only Playwright lock that main's root package.json matches, but it can be dropped if unwanted; (2) the suite's `npm test` script does not set PW_CHROME_PATH, so run it through /apptest or with that variable exported; (3) merge main in and run `node tests/verify.js` once more after resolving, because task-01 also touched index.html, i18n.js and FEATURES.md.
